The assistant’s response is not a correct implementation. It only compares elements at the same index (`arr1[i] == arr2[i]`), so it will miss common elements that appear at different positions. It also references `common_elems` without defining or initializing it, does not handle arrays of different lengths, and uses an extra list despite the “without using any extra data structures” requirement. There is no explanation or consideration of duplicates. Overall, it is fundamentally incorrect.
